newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Tietmeyer says German tax system uncompetitive.
newsitem.headline: Tietmeyer says German tax system uncompetitive.

text.p: Bundesbank President Hans Tietmeyer said on Wednesday that the German tax system was uncompetitive and that reforming it was crucial.
"The German tax system is not competitive enough internally or externally," he told a news conference.
Tietmeyer reiterated that monetary policy cannot solve German economic problems.
"The monetary conditions are all in all appropriate. The problems of the country cannot be solved by monetary policy, but by structural measures," Tietmeyer said.
Tietmeyer added that German growth targets could more or less be attained.
"Cyclically, I expect that the growth will continue in our country and that the growth target set out by the Government will more or less be reached," Tietmeyer said.
